test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - General Awareness (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: A concave spherical mirror has radius of curvature of 30 cm. An object was placed 15 cm away of the pole in front of the mirror on the principal axis. Choose the correct option for the position, size and nature of the image formed, respectively.

options.text: Behind the mirror, enlarged, virtual and erect
At infinity, highly enlarged, real and inverted
Between Focus and Centre, diminished, real and inverted
At the focus, highly diminished point-sized, real and inverted

solution:
The correct answer is **At infinity, highly enlarged, real and inverted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concave Mirror:** The given mirror is a concave spherical mirror.
 
• **Radius of Curvature:** The radius of curvature is 30 cm, so the focal length (f) = R/2 = 15 cm.
 
• **Object Position:** The object is placed 15 cm from the pole, which means it is at the focal point of the mirror.
 
• **Image Nature:** When an object is at the focal point of a concave mirror, the image formed is at infinity, highly enlarged, real, and inverted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Mirror Type
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Concave Mirror**
 A mirror with a surface that curves inward, like the inside of a bowl.
 
 

 **Convex Mirror**
 A mirror with a surface that curves outward, like the outside of a sphere.
 
 

 **Plane Mirror**
 A flat mirror that reflects light to form an upright virtual image the same size as the object.
 
 

 **Focal Point**
 The point where parallel rays of light either converge or appear to diverge after reflecting from the mirror.
 
 

 **Radius of Curvature**
 The distance between the center of curvature and the mirror's surface.
